issues.description: Field Farm.animals: the problem statement requires the farm to store animals in a List<Animal> and to initialize that list with a new ArrayList<>() in the no-argument constructor (so getter/setter signatures should use List<Animal>). The reference solution instead declares the field as private Queue<Animal> animals, initializes it with new LinkedList<>(), and provides getter/setter methods using Queue<Animal>. This mismatch between the specified attribute type (List/ArrayList) and the solution's attribute type (Queue/LinkedList) changes the expected API and can confuse students when they implement the class as instructed in the problem text.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent between specification and implementation. Preferred fix: change the solution to declare the field as private List<Animal> animals; initialize it in the no-arg constructor with new ArrayList<>(); and adjust the getter and setter to return and accept List<Animal>. Alternatively (if the Queue behavior is intentional), update the problem statement to remove the explicit ArrayList requirement and accept a Queue/LinkedList (and update the described getter/setter types) so instructions and reference implementation match.
